description: History and coverage for one company: every fiscal year and every quarter Ticker Scout holds, across every published record, with each period's start and end dates, length, source form and accession, and which records carry it; plus the year-to-date and trailing-twelve-months blocks, and the list of published records (each the snapshot built when one 10-Q or 10-K was filed, with its permanent URLs). Call this to see how far back the data goes before asking for a specific year or quarter. Fiscal years are the company's own: NVIDIA's FY2027 ends in January 2027, Apple's FY2026 ends in September 2026.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol, case-insensitive. Examples: NVDA, brk-b, BRK.B.

title: Every fiscal period and record held
